object.attr: analysis: MELLON-TRACE-SRS-65 moves the last change back past formatting-only commits, so a link acknowledged at such a commit would turn suspect with nothing to review. MELLON-TRACE-SRS-43 and MELLON-TRACE-SRS-47 then read the acknowledged commit as the last change. Requirements review Q13.
object.description: Mellon shall count a link's acknowledged commit as the target's last change when the acknowledged commit descends from the last change and the target's files have the same canonical forms at both.
